mapper.sql: select notice_id, notice_title, notice_type, notice_content, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_notice
mapper.select:
AND notice_title like concat(concat('%',#{noticeTitle}),'%')
AND notice_type = #{noticeType}
AND create_by like concat(concat('%',#{createBy}),'%')
order by CREATE_TIME desc

select notice_id, notice_title, notice_type, notice_content, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_notice where notice_type = 2 and STATUS=0 and rownum < 2 order by CREATE_TIME desc

select notice.notice_id, notice.notice_title, notice.notice_type, notice.notice_content, notice.status, user1.NICK_NAME as create_by, notice.create_time, notice.update_by, notice.update_time, notice.remark from sys_notice notice left join sys_user user1 on user1.USER_NAME =notice.create_by where notice.notice_type = 2 and notice.STATUS=0 order by notice.CREATE_TIME desc
select n.*,u.NICK_NAME from sys_notice n left join sys_user u on u.USER_NAME=n.create_by where n.notice_id = #{noticeId} order by n.CREATE_TIME desc
mapper.insert:
select seq_sys_notice.nextval as noticeId from DUAL
insert into sys_notice ( notice_id, notice_title, notice_type, notice_content, status, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{noticeId}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeType}, #{noticeContent}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate )
mapper.delete:
delete from sys_notice where notice_id in
#{noticeId}
